newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's assigns A1 rating to M'shita Elec Works.
newsitem.headline: Moody's assigns A1 rating to M'shita Elec Works.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday that it had assigned its A1 counterparty rating to Matsushita Electric Works Ltd.

The rating reflects the company's strong brand franchise across a broad array of building products and related electrical equipment products for domestic consumers and industrial consumers, Moody's said.
The rating is also supported by the company's sound financial profile, predictable cash flow and conservative financial policies, Moody's said.
